def find_olympiad_year(abbreviation):
    base_year = 1989
    year_digits = int(abbreviation.split('\'')[1])
    return base_year + year_digits

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    abbreviations = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
    for abbreviation in abbreviations:
        year = find_olympiad_year(abbreviation)
        print(year)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
